definitions.full: H5073. nidbak נִדְבָּךְ noun masculine row or layer, course ( ᵑ7 Late Hebrew id. ; Late Hebrew also מִדְבָּךְ id. (Levy NHWB iii. 23 ), compare as loan-word Frä 12 ; borrowed from Assyrian nadbaku, mountain-slope according to Dl Pr 150 (compare Ba ZA ii. 115 f. Hpt GN 1883, 96 ; BAS i. 8.15), but meaning not very suitable Nö ZMG xi (1886), 733 Mey Entst. J. 46 ); — absolute ׳נ Ezra 6:4 , plural נִדְבָּכִין 6:4 .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick;
